title: ts#greengrass-component
description: Add an AWS IoT Greengrass component to a TypeScript project

project.description: The typescript project to add the Greengrass component to
project.x-prompt: Select the project to add the Greengrass component to

name.description: The name of the component to add
name.x-prompt: What name would you like your Greengrass component to have? i.e: MyComponent

componentName.description: The recipe ComponentName. Defaults to a reversed-domain name derived from your workspace's npm scope and the component name, eg. com.myscope.MyComponent.

componentVersion.description: The initial recipe ComponentVersion. Written into recipe.yaml once; the recipe is user-owned from then on. NEXT_PATCH, NEXT_MINOR or NEXT_MAJOR instead of a number resolves the version at deploy time from the highest version already published - see the guide.

publisher.description: The recipe ComponentPublisher. Defaults to the greengrass.publisher set in aws-nx-plugin.config.mts, else your workspace's npm scope.

ipc.description: Whether to wire the Greengrass IPC client (aws-iot-device-sdk-v2) and a least-privilege accessControl block scoped to the component's own topic. Off by default only for continuity of existing invocations - on adds about 2.3MB of vendored aws-crt native addon to the artifact per targeted architecture.
ipc.x-prompt: Would you like to use the Greengrass IPC client to publish/subscribe to local topics? (adds a vendored native addon to the artifact)

platform.description: The core device platform(s) to target. linux-amd64-arm64 writes one recipe manifest per architecture so a single component version serves both.
platform.x-prompt: Which core device platform(s) would you like to target?

infra.description: Infrastructure to provision for this component. component-version vends a GreengrassComponentVersion CDK construct or Terraform module that publishes this component's built artifact.
infra.x-prompt: Which infrastructure would you like to provision?

iac.description: The preferred IaC provider. By default this is inherited from your initial selection.
iac.x-prompt: Which provider would you like to manage your infrastructure? (default: Inherit)

preferInstallDependencies.description: Whether to prefer installing dependencies after the generator runs. Set to false to defer installing when batching multiple generators (an install still runs if needed so subsequent generators can compute the Nx project graph); install once at the end.
